executive_summary: Dan spends approximately 15 hours per week on repetitive administrative tasks that could be largely automated. Implementing the identified quick wins will reclaim 7 hours weekly, freeing up strategic time worth $160 per hour.

pain_points.title: Manual Data Entry & Spreadsheet Management
pain_points.description: Copying data between systems, updating spreadsheets, and reconciling records consumes 4-5 hours weekly.

pain_points.title: Email Overload & Manual Sorting
pain_points.description: Sifting through 100+ emails daily to find action items, respond to routine queries, and manage inbox organization takes 2-3 hours.

pain_points.title: Manual Scheduling & Calendar Coordination
pain_points.description: Back-and-forth emails to schedule meetings, update calendars, and send reminders consumes 1-2 hours weekly.

pain_points.title: Document Creation & Templating
pain_points.description: Building proposals, reports, and documents from scratch rather than using templates takes 2-3 hours weekly.

pain_points.title: Follow-up & Reminder Management
pain_points.description: Manually tracking and sending follow-ups to clients, suppliers, and team members takes 1-2 hours weekly.

quick_wins.title: AI Email Management & Auto-Response
quick_wins.description: Deploy an AI assistant to categorize emails, draft responses to routine queries, and flag only items requiring personal attention.

quick_wins.title: Smart Scheduling Automation
quick_wins.description: Implement calendar scheduling links and automated reminder sequences to eliminate back-and-forth coordination.

quick_wins.title: Document Templates & Auto-Generation
quick_wins.description: Create reusable templates for common documents and use merge fields to auto-populate data, cutting proposal and report creation time by 70%.

deeper_opportunities.title: AI Data Entry Agent
deeper_opportunities.description: Automatically extract and enter data from emails, forms, and documents into your CRM or database, eliminating manual copying entirely.

deeper_opportunities.title: Intelligent Workflow Orchestration
deeper_opportunities.description: Connect all business systems with smart automation that triggers actions across platforms based on events and schedules.

deeper_opportunities.title: AI-Powered Client Communication Hub
deeper_opportunities.description: Centralize all client touchpoints with an AI that maintains context, drafts personalized communications, and tracks relationship health.

tool_recommendations.name: Superhuman
tool_recommendations.purpose: AI-powered email management with automatic categorization, follow-up reminders, and response drafting.

tool_recommendations.name: Calendly
tool_recommendations.purpose: Eliminate scheduling back-and-forth with shareable booking links and automated reminders.

tool_recommendations.name: Notion
tool_recommendations.purpose: Centralized workspace with reusable templates for documents, proposals, and knowledge management.

tool_recommendations.name: Make
tool_recommendations.purpose: Connect apps and automate workflows between email, calendar, documents, and databases.
